## Où j'en suis

The PG17 blue/green Terraform work for the analytics RDS is written and linted on branch noa/rds-pg17: module parameter group family is derived from engine version, staging is set to 17.2 with blue/green enabled, prod is prepared but disabled, and the AWS provider is pinned to ~> 5.82.0. A draft PR (#57) is open with plans verified (staging: 1 add/1 change; prod: no changes); nothing has been applied.

- [en-cours] pg_partman 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 upgrade on staging 16.4, plus a check of run_maintenance_proc() on events_raw/events_daily — not yet run (source: t10)
- [prochaine-étape] pick a production window only after Maya signs off, avoiding the dbt lock on events_daily (01:00–03:30 UTC); candidate slots Sat/Sun 04:00–06:00 UTC (source: t14)
- [essai-raté] letting init select AWS provider v6 produced 37 unrelated breaking changes; reverted to a ~> 5.82.0 pin (source: t04)
- [essai-raté] proposed prod cutover Sat 28 Nov 02:00 UTC with apply_immediately = true — rejected: falls inside the dbt lock, apply_immediately stays false (source: t14)
- [décision] no production date until Maya signs off on the whole upgrade (source: t14)
